## Hi! I'm Sofia! 

:::: {layout-ncol=2}

:::{#first-column}



I recently graduated with a Masters of Environmental Data Science from the Bren School of Environmental Science & Management. I have experience working in field biology, environmental policy, and marine conservation. I'm excited to tackle conservation and sustainability issues that combine my diverse skills and areas of interest. My career goal is to analyze multifaceted environmental problems while combating environmental justice issues. I am most interested in marine conservation, toxins reduction, and equitable environmental resources for all.
